findings.issue: The 2mp suffixes on the reaping and the land are rendered with su, which also marks a third party. Beside the tú forms, that opening can be read as another participant; the 2pl address is explicit only in Dios de ustedes.
findings.spanishSpan: su segar la cosecha de su tierra

findings.issue: peregrino in current Spanish commonly means a pilgrim or wanderer. The token is the sojourner/resident stranger, and a pilgrimage sense is not licensed.

notes: Tú matches the 2ms verbs; Jehová and Dios de ustedes match the close; no unmarked copula was added.
